knowledge.plain_language_summary: A building directory: a 3/8in aluminum backer plate with a 1/8in applied aluminum panel carrying a digitally printed 3M high-performance vinyl directory with matte laminate, silicone-stud mounted.
knowledge.rationale: Digital-print on an applied panel lets the directory be revised by reprinting; the backer plate gives a flush stud mount.

structure.construction: 3/8in aluminum backer + 1/8in applied aluminum panel, 3M HP vinyl digital print + matte laminate, silicone-filled stud mount

materials_manifest.product: 3M high-performance vinyl digital print + matte laminate, PMS 447C

craft_observations: Digital-print directory revisable by reprinting the applied panel.
